acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using ChefFlow, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our service.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.content: We collect and use your data solely to provide and improve ChefFlow services:

points.personal: Personal information (name, email) for account management
points.recipes: Your recipes and meal plans for service functionality
points.planning: Usage patterns to improve user experience
points.improvement: Aggregated, anonymous data for service improvements

dataUse.noCommercial: We will never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data at any time. If you wish to delete your account and all associated data, please contact us at
userRights.contactSuffix: and we will process your request within 30 days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience, keep you logged in, and analyze service usage. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms occasionally. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through our service.
